FISHING LICENCE · CANADA

Alberta fishing licence

Visitors aged 16 and older need a sportfishing licence. The senior exemption applies only to Alberta residents.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Visitors aged 16 and older, unless another exemption applies.

Who doesn’t

  • Children under 16.
  • Alberta residents aged 65 and older.
  • Holders of a Certificate of Indian Status under the Indian Act.

Rules visitors should know

  • Obtain a Wildlife Identification Number before an online purchase.
  • Exempt anglers must still follow the sportfishing rules.

How to buy

Buy through AlbertaRELM after you obtain a Wildlife Identification Number.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Alberta?

Visitors aged 16 and older need a sportfishing licence. The senior exemption applies only to Alberta residents.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Alberta?

Non-resident Canadian annual: $62 CAD; Non-resident Canadian 1-day: $27 CAD; Non-resident Canadian 7-day: $43 CAD; Visitor from outside Canada annual: $87 CAD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Alberta?

Buy through AlbertaRELM after you obtain a Wildlife Identification Number.
